name: The Warden
concept: A grappler with chains, on one 26-card deck. One combo route, and not often: Chain Lash (the only Starter), Ankle Hook (the only Linker), Coil (the only Ender). His grabs hit harder than anyone's and every Counter he holds is a grab. Shakedown and Coil take a card, Shackles cuts their hand to 5, Chain Toss is a Safe poke; his specials are Iron Haul and Chain Whip, and Chain Prison cuts their hand to 3.

cards.name: Haul In
cards.flavour: Drag them in before they can set.

cards.name: Shackles
cards.flavour: Chained up, you can't carry much.

cards.name: Recall
cards.flavour: Cover up, then bring back what you need.

cards.name: Charge
cards.flavour: Cover up and build the bar.

cards.name: Iron Haul
cards.flavour: The chain finds you before you move.

cards.name: Chain Whip
cards.flavour: A crack of the chain from out of reach.

notes: v19 tuning: HP 33 and grabs +3 (Shakedown, Haul In, Shackles, Iron Haul 5; Coil, Chain Prison 6): his grabs are no longer his punishes, so they can hit hard. v19 test (8 November 2026): Counter icons only on Pressures (Mark), played with the grey cap (9). Moved from the v18 file: every Convert loses Counter; Chain Lash, Ankle Hook, Chain Whip gain it. Rules v18. 8 November 2026 (evening), Mark: his chains should combo, just not regularly: one route (Chain Lash Starter, Ankle Hook Linker, Coil Ender; Chain Spin and Chain Whip have no combo icons), and a smaller grab buff: +1 chip (Shakedown, Haul In, Shackles, Iron Haul 3; Coil, Chain Prison 4). Against the 7 November Benchmark 44.2% (47.3%, 41.1%; two seeds of 400); beats Vex 55.8% (300). With grabs +2: 53.4% and Vex 66.3%; graded (+1 fast, +2 slow): 47.2% and Vex 64.8%. The no-combo, grabs +3 version (50.8%, Vex 73%) is variants/warden-nocombo-grab3.json. Rules v18. 8 November 2026 (afternoon): Chain Toss is Safe with no icons (Mark: a long-range move isn't a combo starter), and Build 3, chip 2 like the Benchmark's Shot. Against the 7 November Benchmark: 41.8% (42.3%, 41.3%; two seeds of 400); 37.3% at Build 2, chip 1; 46.9% as a Safe Starter (variants/warden-26-safetoss-starter.json); at HP 34, 45.1%. Also 8 November: 26 cards to match the other fighters (Mark), adding Haul In x1 (cut to fit 24 on 3 November) and a third Ankle Hook: Pressure 9, Convert 10, Recover 7. In sim against the 7 November Benchmark it changed nothing (44.2% at 24 and at 26, two seeds of 400); the 24-card deck is variants/warden-24.json. 3 November: the shared defence core (Recall, Charge, Read); Chain Toss and Chain Spin are plain attacks now. HP 32: against the HP 34 (3 November) Benchmark he won 41% at 30, 49% at 32 and 57% at 34 in sim.
